not_executed_rule.scope: NOT-EXECUTED-BY-RULE is an active-reference implementation classification only. In the lifted fixed Program the corresponding positions are REQUIRED logical values assigned the canonical inactive representation tau(e) = bot; there is no not-required-because-not-executed category.

not_executed_by_rule.rule: R17-1: a request that served a_r < cap tokens (its served token a_r-1 a declared EOS id of the Program's stop rule) executed exactly n_exec = min(a_r + LAG, cap) request-relative steps; a request served to its cap executed cap (a length stop: no post-EOS row even if the cap token is an EOS). RequiredValues(P, Q_module_v1) stays the cap-length manifest of record (fixed population across stopping points, BRIEF 7B; digest unchanged): its identities at request-relative steps >= n_exec are the named class not-executed(R17-1, a_r, LAG) -- counted in query_total, absent from the sampling pool, never 'not evaluated' and never silently absent; reached + uncovered + not-executed == |Q(P)|. CONDITIONS (R17-27): (a) a_r is READ from the Match record of record (G6 lengths_by_request / tokens.json) and the Commit's own committed served length must EQUAL it by name -- the committed tokens count only because they are linked to the served output and the Match account (C2 boundary linkage + tokens_equal + G6 agree); 'the committer says EOS happened here' is never sufficient; (b) LAG is the Program's declared static (workload_lag_static), attested declared == record_attests == tokens.json; (c) any committed row of the request at a step >= arrival + n_exec is 'execution past the stop' and FAILS. A request failing any condition is NOT classified: its prefix carries faults and the record's query_checks fail by name. NOT-EXECUTED-BY-RULE is an active-reference implementation classification only. In the lifted fixed Program the corresponding positions are REQUIRED logical values assigned the canonical inactive representation tau(e) = bot; there is no not-required-because-not-executed category.

not_executed_rule.scope: NOT-EXECUTED-BY-RULE is an active-reference implementation classification only. In the lifted fixed Program the corresponding positions are REQUIRED logical values assigned the canonical inactive representation tau(e) = bot; there is no not-required-because-not-executed category.

not_executed_by_rule.rule: R17-1: a request that served a_r < cap tokens (its served token a_r-1 a declared EOS id of the Program's stop rule) executed exactly n_exec = min(a_r + LAG, cap) request-relative steps; a request served to its cap executed cap (a length stop: no post-EOS row even if the cap token is an EOS). RequiredValues(P, Q_module_v1) stays the cap-length manifest of record (fixed population across stopping points, BRIEF 7B; digest unchanged): its identities at request-relative steps >= n_exec are the named class not-executed(R17-1, a_r, LAG) -- counted in query_total, absent from the sampling pool, never 'not evaluated' and never silently absent; reached + uncovered + not-executed == |Q(P)|. CONDITIONS (R17-27): (a) a_r is READ from the Match record of record (G6 lengths_by_request / tokens.json) and the Commit's own committed served length must EQUAL it by name -- the committed tokens count only because they are linked to the served output and the Match account (C2 boundary linkage + tokens_equal + G6 agree); 'the committer says EOS happened here' is never sufficient; (b) LAG is the Program's declared static (workload_lag_static), attested declared == record_attests == tokens.json; (c) any committed row of the request at a step >= arrival + n_exec is 'execution past the stop' and FAILS. A request failing any condition is NOT classified: its prefix carries faults and the record's query_checks fail by name.
